note: La cuisine (s02maison repaint 2026-10-22): big ground-floor family kitchen (plan), camera facing north. White walls, blue-and-white Delft tile band, grey flagstones, dark ceiling beams, scrubbed table; LANDMARK the white enamel range on the left wall (the bright white range seen through the kitchen_02 arch and the living-room door). Back (north) wall: stone archway into the mint-green scullery with the hand pump (R_kitchen_02). Left (west) wall: half-glazed door to the laundry (R_laundry_01). Right (east) wall: door at the back to the sage-green living room with its white stairs (R_living). The table is the zoom spot (z1, Le coin des frigos). Feminine left: young queen in crown and apron stirring soup at the white range (cuisine), girl drawing a V on the misted glass pane of the laundry door (vitre). Masculine right: hen warming herself by the black pot-bellied stove (poêle), cook holding up four fingers by the brick bread oven (four), man frying eggs on the cream coal range (fourneau), hippo blowing bubbles in a giant pot (pot), blank cream museum plaque for le cendrier (museum_text: no ashtray painted; staged display change, see README).
